messages.content: How do I deploy a model to Azure AI Foundry?

Here's how to deploy models to Azure AI Foundry:

## Using Azure AI Studio

1. Go to [ai.azure.com](https://ai.azure.com)
2. Create a new project or select existing
3. Navigate to **Deployments** > **Deploy model**
4. Choose your model (GPT-4, Llama, Phi, etc.)
5. Configure deployment settings
6. Deploy!

## Using Azure CLI
```bash
# Login
az login

# Create deployment
az ml online-deployment create \
    --name my-deployment \
    --endpoint-name my-endpoint \
    --model azureml://registries/azureml/models/gpt-4/versions/1 \
    --instance-type Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4
```

## Using Python SDK
```python
from azure.ai.ml import MLClient
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

client = MLClient(
    DefaultAzureCredential(),
    subscription_id="...",
    resource_group_name="...",
    workspace_name="..."
)

# Deploy model
deployment = client.online_deployments.begin_create_or_update(
    deployment_config
).result()
```
How do I use the local development server?

Azure AI Foundry provides a local development server:

## Install AI Foundry CLI
```bash
pip install azure-ai-foundry
```

## Start Local Server
```bash
# Start with default settings (port 5272)
ai-foundry serve --model phi-3-mini

# Custom port
ai-foundry serve --model phi-3-mini --port 8080
```

## Connect from Code
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="http://localhost:5272/v1",
    api_key="local"  # Not required for local
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="phi-3-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
```

## Environment Variable
```bash
export AZURE_AI_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:5272
```

The local server is great for development before deploying to Azure!
